title: Naturality of the ordinary scalar Kummer Chern realization
statement: For a morphism f:X→Y of schemes on which N is invertible, a ring A killed by N, and a normalized finite twist transport, let M be a Picard class on Y. If the ordinaryFiniteClass of c:A_Y→A_Y(1)[2] is its scalar Kummer Chern class, then the ordinaryFiniteClass of c pulled through the canonical constant-object comparison and the normalized shifted line comparison is the scalar Kummer Chern class of Pic.map f M [def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, lem-amb-kummer-any-base].

proof.text: Resolve module sheaves and evaluate the forgotten Ext class on the integral generator. Exact inverse image and the canonical constant comparison send this generator to the generator. The normalized scalar line comparison sends each root tensor a to its pullback tensor a. Consequently ordinaryFiniteClass of the transported arrow is cohomology pullback of the original scalar class.

proof.text: Use naturality of the Kummer connecting map, then naturality of the Picard/frame-torsor comparison, to identify the result with the scalar Chern class of Pic.map f M. The adopted source theorem Scheme.gmCohomologyMap_toCohomologicalPicardGroup already proves this Picard naturality for arbitrary schemes; no curve-specialized interface is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem ordinaryFiniteChern_pullback (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A]
    (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0) (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (hX : IsUnit (N : Γ(X, ⊤))) (M : Y.Pic)
    (c : ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y ⟶ (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA Y)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)
    (hc : ordinaryFiniteClass A Y (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine Y N A hA) 2 c =
      Sheaf.H.map (ordinaryFiniteRootMap A N hA Y) 2
        (Y.kummerδ₁ N hY (Scheme.Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroup Y M))) :
    ordinaryFiniteClass A X (Scheme.finiteEtaleTateLine X N A hA) 2
        (ordinaryFiniteLinePullbackMap A N hA t f hY c) =
      Sheaf.H.map (ordinaryFiniteRootMap A N hA X) 2
        (X.kummerδ₁ N hX
          (Scheme.Pic.toCohomologicalPicardGroup X (Scheme.Pic.map f M)))
lean.note: ordinaryFiniteLinePullbackMap records the existing constant comparison, inverse-image map and shifted normalized line comparison. Its body is the displayed canonical composite, with no choice or postponed data. The naturality statement uses this compact interface. Reviewer fix (efdbda997e1d): the hole is closed by `import all Sheaf.AlgebraicGeometry.FiniteP1ChernMapBaseChange` and its private class_chern_pullback and kummer_class_pullback; the statement is unchanged and the theorem uses only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
